column1: # Forever items: the new and changed item rows of spec jvbastel/WOWAI#225. forever/generator writes each into
# forever_item_template (world database): a copy of the stock row of its source item with the spec values on
# top. The 1.12 client has no item table: it asks the server for each item, so items need no client data.
# Never edit a generated file by hand. To gather the data again, see forever/REFRESH.md.
# Source: WoW Forever build 1.60.1.70685, recorded 2026-10-30: the local Forever client (ItemSparse and Item,
# the dump items.tsv of #224, whose stats come from the allocations of ItemSparse), compared with the stock
# 1.12 item_template rows. Only numbers and names.
# Free item ID range: 70000-79999. A new item takes its ID from here. The stock 1.12 world database ends at item
# 25818. Next free item ID: 70384 (70382-70383: the ores of mining.tsv).
# 71000-71699 are the blocks of the dungeon loot items (spec #240, forever/REFRESH.md "Dungeon loot").
# Stats: the 1.12 item has five base stats (Str, Agi, Sta, Int, Spi) and Health and Mana in `stats`, and the
# six resistances in `resistances`. Every other Forever stat is a bonus: a stock 1.12 equip spell
# (forever/generator/forever_gen/equip_stats.py names them). Forever ratings become 1.12 percents at level 60:
# 14 crit rating = 1% Crit, 10 hit = 1% Hit, 12 dodge = 1% Dodge, 15 parry = 1% Parry, 5 block = 1% Block,
# 1 defense rating = 1 Defense. Forever bonus armor is added to `armor`, as on the stock items. A value with
# no stock spell is rounded to the nearest value that has one, up on a tie, and keeps its Forever value:
# "SpellPower 11 (Forever 10)". `foreverStats` keeps the Forever stats as the client has them.
# Changed stock crafted items (#227): 117 rows of the kind `stock`. They keep their stock IDs. Among them 23
# white items that became green, 39 new weapon speeds, 27 Main Hand weapons that became One-Hand, the Golden
# Scale set (Spirit -> Stamina) and the Thorium resistance set (+Stamina).
# Excluded (in encrypted client data that build 1.60.1.70685 cannot read): 12779, 22762, 22763, 22764.
# but their Forever resistances and all-resist stat (124) are the stock resistance columns and spell 18676. Darkspear
# (12802): its Forever equip spell 1314143 procs the stock spell 16939 (5% chance) with a 60 s cooldown; it keeps
# 16939, and the 1.12 item row has no column for the cooldown.
# Columns (tab-separated). In inventoryType, delay, damage, resistances, bonuses and equipSpells, "-" keeps
# the value of the source row.
#   kind           item: a new item, from the free item range, a copy of another item (sourceItem)
#                  stock: a changed stock item; entry = sourceItem, a stock ID below the free item range
#   sourceItem     the stock item whose row is copied: class, subclass, slot, material, durability, sheath
#   quality        poor, common, uncommon, rare or epic
#   bonding        none, pickup, equip or use
#   inventoryType  the slot: oneHand, mainHand, offHand, twoHand, shield, ranged, holdable, or -
#   delay          the weapon speed in ms, or -
#   armor          the armor value (with the Forever bonus armor)
#   resistances    "<Holy|Fire|Nature|Frost|Shadow|Arcane> <value>", separated by commas (the others are 0),
#   stats          base stats: "<Str|Agi|Sta|Int|Spi|Health|Mana> <value>", separated by commas, or -
#   bonuses        "<bonus> <value>" or "<bonus> <rounded> (Forever <value>)", separated by commas, or -
#   equipSpells    other stock spells that the item gives on equip, separated by commas, or -. With bonuses
#                  or equipSpells set, the item's on-equip spells are these, and a stock item keeps its other
#                  spells (on use, chance on hit). With both -, a stock item keeps all its spells.
#   displayId      a stock ItemDisplayInfo.dbc ID (the model and the icon)
#   foreverItem    the item ID in the Forever client
#   foreverStats   the Forever stats as the client has them
#   notes          free text: for a stock item, what changed from stock
